# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(exactextractr)
library(NbClust)
library(factoextra)
library(geocmeans)
library(tmap)

# Create spatial references
pixel_size <- 1000
epsg <- 5070

# Get county boundaries
aoi <- tigris::counties("ID") %>%
  filter(NAME %in% c("Jefferson", "Gem", "Madison", "Clark", "Jerome", "Bonneville", "Teton", "Power", "Blaine", "Elmore", "Butte", "Adams", "Minidoka", "Bingham", "Ada", "Cassia", "Payette", "Fremont", "Bannock", "Twin Falls", "Owyhee", "Washington", "Gooding", "Lincoln", "Camas", "Canyon")) %>%
  st_transform(epsg)
```

NCP data from chapter 1:

```{r}
#| label: "get NCP data"

# get list of file paths
NCP_data_files <- list.files("../data/NCP_data", pattern = ".tif",
                             full.names = TRUE,
                             recursive = TRUE)

# read data files into list
NCP_data <- lapply(NCP_data_files, function(x) rast(x))
names(NCP_data) <- NCP_data_files %>%
  str_remove("../data/NCP_data/") %>%
  str_remove(".tif")

# check that all are aligned
# careful with this step - it may apply spatial functions that can warp data
template <- NCP_data[[1]]
aligned_rasts <- lapply(NCP_data, function(x) {
  if(crs(x) != crs(template)) {x <- project(x, template)}
  if(sum(res(x) != res(template)) > 0) {x <- resample(x, template)}
  if(sum(origin(x) != origin(template)) > 0) {x <- resample(x, template)}
  if(sum(ext(x) != ext(template)) > 0) {x <- resample(x, template)}
  
  return(x)
})

NCP_data <- rast(aligned_rasts)
names(NCP_data) <- names(aligned_rasts)
```

# By-County Clustering

Extract NCP info for each county:

```{r}
NCP_by_county <- exact_extract(x = NCP_data,
                               y = aoi,
                               fun = "mean")
rownames(NCP_by_county) <- aoi$NAME

# NCP_by_county_sum <- exact_extract(x = NCP_data,
#                                y = aoi,
#                                fun = "sum")
# rownames(NCP_by_county_sum) <- aoi$NAME
# NCP_by_county_sum_per_km2 <- NCP_by_county_sum %>%
#   cbind(., area=units::set_units(st_area(aoi), "km2")) %>%
#   mutate(across(`sum.climate_mitigation/Carroll_2018_climate_stability`:`sum.water_quality/watershed_retention-load_ratio`, ~units::drop_units(.x/area))) %>%
#   select(-area)
```

Build a data frame for clustering:

```{r}
# remove highly correlated variables
corrplot::corrplot(cor(NCP_by_county), tl.cex=0.3, method="number")

NCP_reduced <- NCP_by_county %>%
  select(-c(`mean.climate_mitigation/tot_c_cur_1km`,
            `mean.food_and_feed/5-yr_CropYieldValue`,
            #`mean.recreation/rec_prob`,
            `mean.habitat/hab_quality_1km`,
            `mean.habitat/TNC_terrestrial_resilience_z-score_adj`))

corrplot::corrplot(cor(NCP_reduced), tl.cex=0.3, method="number")

# scale data
NCP_clustering_data <- scale(NCP_reduced)

# get estimated number of clusters
num_clusts_rec <- NbClust(NCP_clustering_data,
                          max.nc = 9, 
                          method = "kmeans",
                          index = "all")

# create Kmeans clusters
NCP_clusters <- kmeans(NCP_clustering_data,
                       centers = 3)
```

Alternate method: PCA-based kmeans following the methods of Aho et al., 2022

```{r}
# scale data
NCP_clustering_data_pca <- scale(NCP_by_county)

# run overall PCA
all_ncp_pca <- prcomp(NCP_clustering_data_pca)
summary(all_ncp_pca) # keep PC1-6 (explain >90% of variance)

# weight PCA scores by their eigenvalue
pca_clustering_data <- t(apply(all_ncp_pca$x[,1:6],
                             MARGIN = 1,
                             function(row) {row * (all_ncp_pca$sdev^2)[1:6]}))

# apply kmeans clustering approach
# get estimated number of clusters
num_clusts_rec <- NbClust(pca_clustering_data,
                          max.nc = 9, 
                          method = "kmeans",
                          index = "all")

# create Kmeans clusters
NCP_clusters_pca <- kmeans(pca_clustering_data,
                           centers = 3)
```


Assess clusters:

```{r}
# plot results of kmeans model
fviz_cluster(NCP_clusters, data = NCP_clustering_data)
fviz_cluster(NCP_clusters_pca, data = NCP_by_county)

# plot clusters on map
plot(cbind(aoi, NCP_clusters$cluster)["NCP_clusters.cluster"])
plot(cbind(aoi, NCP_clusters_pca$cluster)["NCP_clusters_pca.cluster"])

# visualize differences
NCP_by_county_clusts <- data.frame(cbind(NCP_clustering_data, NCP_clusters$cluster)) %>%
  rename("cluster" = "V18") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("mean."),
               names_to = "NCP",
               values_to = "mean")

NCP_by_county_clusts_pca <- data.frame(cbind(scale(NCP_by_county), NCP_clusters_pca$cluster)) %>%
  rename("cluster" = "V22") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("mean."),
               names_to = "NCP",
               values_to = "mean")

# boxplots of all included NCP
ggplot(NCP_by_county_clusts) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = mean, y = NCP),
               outliers = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(facets = "cluster")

ggplot(NCP_by_county_clusts_pca) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = mean, y = NCP),
               outliers = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(facets = "cluster")

# variant with those overlapping 0 removed
whisker_lengths <- NCP_by_county_clusts %>%
  group_by(cluster, NCP) %>%
  summarise(upper_whisker = min(max(mean), quantile(mean, 0.75) + 1.5 * IQR(mean)),
            lower_whisker = max(min(mean), quantile(mean, 0.25) - 1.5 * IQR(mean))) %>%
  mutate(touches_zero = ifelse(upper_whisker>0 & lower_whisker>0, FALSE,
                               ifelse(upper_whisker<0 & lower_whisker<0, FALSE, TRUE))) %>%
  select(-c(upper_whisker, lower_whisker))

whisker_lengths_pca <- NCP_by_county_clusts_pca %>%
  group_by(cluster, NCP) %>%
  summarise(upper_whisker = min(max(mean), quantile(mean, 0.75) + 1.5 * IQR(mean)),
            lower_whisker = max(min(mean), quantile(mean, 0.25) - 1.5 * IQR(mean))) %>%
  mutate(touches_zero = ifelse(upper_whisker>0 & lower_whisker>0, FALSE,
                               ifelse(upper_whisker<0 & lower_whisker<0, FALSE, TRUE))) %>%
  select(-c(upper_whisker, lower_whisker))

left_join(NCP_by_county_clusts, whisker_lengths) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = mean, y = NCP,
                   fill = touches_zero),
               outliers = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(facets = "cluster")

left_join(NCP_by_county_clusts_pca, whisker_lengths_pca) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = mean, y = NCP,
                   fill = touches_zero),
               outliers = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(facets = "cluster")

# compare maps between PCA and non-PCA
clust_comb <- do.call(cbind, list(aoi, 
                                  non_pca_clusters = NCP_clusters$cluster, 
                                  pca_clusters = NCP_clusters_pca$cluster)) %>%
  # assign similar clusters the same number
  mutate(non_pca_clusters = ifelse(non_pca_clusters == 1, 3,
                ifelse(non_pca_clusters == 2, 1, 2))) %>%
  pivot_longer(pca_clusters:non_pca_clusters,
               names_to = "method",
               values_to = "cluster") %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = factor(cluster))) +
  facet_wrap(vars(method)) +
  theme_void()
clust_comb
```

Compare to Cmeans clustering:

```{r}
Cmean <- CMeans(data = NCP_clustering_data,
                k = 3,
                m = 1.5,
                maxiter = 500,
                standardize = FALSE, 
                seed = 456, 
                tol = 0.00001, 
                verbose = FALSE)
calcqualityIndexes(NCP_clustering_data, Cmean$Belongings, m = 1.5)

beta_values <- selectParameters("GFCM", data = NCP_clustering_data, 
                                k = 4, m = 1.5,
                                beta = seq(0,1,0.05), spconsist = FALSE,
                                tol = 0.00001, seed = 456)
knitr::kable(beta_values[c("beta","Silhouette.index","XieBeni.index","Explained.inertia")],
             col.names = c("beta", "silhouette index", "Xie and Beni index", "explained inertia"),
             digits = 3)
# we want all three to be high but need to choose a balance
# choosing beta = 0.45

GCmean <- GCMeans(NCP_clustering_data,
                  k = 3,
                  m = 1.5, 
                  beta = 0.45,
                  500,standardize = FALSE, seed=456,
                  tol = 0.00001, verbose = FALSE)
r1 <- calcqualityIndexes(NCP_clustering_data, GCmean$Belongings,m=1.5)
r2 <- calcqualityIndexes(NCP_clustering_data, Cmean$Belongings,m=1.5)
df <- cbind(unlist(r1), unlist(r2))

knitr::kable(df,
             digits = 3,col.names = c("GFCM", "FCM"))
# like the vignette, the GFCM provides a solution that is less fuzzy (higher explained inertia and lower partition entropy) but keeps a good silhouette index and an even better Xie and Beni index.

cmeansMaps<- mapClusters(aoi,Cmean$Belongings,undecided = 0.45)
GcmeansMaps<- mapClusters(aoi,GCmean$Belongings,undecided = 0.45)
tmap_arrange(cmeansMaps$ProbaMaps[[1]],GcmeansMaps$ProbaMaps[[1]], nrow = 1, ncol = 2)
tmap_arrange(cmeansMaps$ProbaMaps[[2]],GcmeansMaps$ProbaMaps[[2]], 
          nrow = 1, ncol = 2)
tmap_arrange(cmeansMaps$ProbaMaps[[3]],GcmeansMaps$ProbaMaps[[3]], 
          nrow = 1, ncol = 2)

clusterC <- apply(Cmean$Belongings, MARGIN = 1, 
                  FUN = function(x) which.max(x))
clusterGC <- apply(GCmean$Belongings, MARGIN = 1, 
                  FUN = function(x) which.max(x))
clusterK <- NCP_clusters$cluster

# all same groupings except Twin Falls
plot(cbind(aoi, clusterK)["clusterK"], main = "Kmeans clusters")
plot(cbind(aoi, clusterC)["clusterC"], main = "Cmeans clusters")
plot(cbind(aoi, clusterGC)["clusterGC"], main = "Gen. Cmeans clusters")

spiderPlots(NCP_clustering_data, GCmean$Belongings,
            chartcolors = c("darkorange3","darkgreen","royalblue"))

# ensuring clustering stability
bootvalues <- boot_group_validation(GCmean, nsim = 1000, maxiter = 1000, 
                                     tol = 0.0001, verbose = FALSE)
melted_df <- reshape2::melt(bootvalues$group_consistency)
melted_df$variable <- as.factor(melted_df$variable)
ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(mapping = aes(x = value), data = melted_df, bins = 30) +
  labs(title = "stability of clusters", subtitle = "for 1000 iterations",
       x = "Jaccard index") +
  facet_wrap(vars(variable), ncol=2)

# group 1 is particularly unstable
df_gp1 <- bootvalues$group_centers[["group1"]]
melted_df <- reshape2::melt(df_gp1)
melted_df$variable <- as.factor(melted_df$variable)
ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(mapping = aes(x = value), data = melted_df, bins = 30) +
  labs(title = "stability of group 3 centers", subtitle = "for 1000 iterations") +
  xlim(-3,3)+
  facet_wrap(vars(variable), ncol=3)
# the center values aren't really centered
# not sure what that means
```


# Spatial Clustering

The first code chunk follows the vignette for geocmeans for rasters

```{r}
# fill NCP NAs with 0
for(i in c(9, 11, 13)) {
  aligned_rasts[[i]] <- mask(ifel(is.na(aligned_rasts[[i]]), 
                                0, aligned_rasts[[i]]),
                           aligned_rasts[[1]])
}

# finding an appropriate k and m values (using a multicore plan)
future::plan(future::multisession(workers = 2))
FCMvalues <- select_parameters.mc(algo = "FCM", data = aligned_rasts, 
                               k = 2:12, m = seq(1.1,2,0.1), 
                               spconsist = FALSE, 
                               indices = c("XieBeni.index",
                                           "Explained.inertia",
                                           "Negentropy.index",
                                           "Silhouette.index"),
                               verbose = TRUE)

# plotting the silhouette index values
ggplot(FCMvalues) + 
  geom_raster(aes(x = m, y = k, fill = Silhouette.index)) + 
  geom_text(aes(x = m, y = k, label = round(Silhouette.index,2)), size = 2)+
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_fixed(ratio=0.125) 

# plotting the explained inertia
ggplot(FCMvalues) + 
  geom_raster(aes(x = m, y = k, fill = Explained.inertia)) + 
  geom_text(aes(x = m, y = k, label = round(Explained.inertia,2)), size = 2)+
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_fixed(ratio=0.125)

# choosing k=4 and m=1.1

FCM_result <- CMeans(aligned_rasts, k = 4, m = 1.1, standardize = TRUE,
                     verbose = FALSE, seed = 789, tol = 0.001, init = "kpp")

maps1 <- mapClusters(object = FCM_result, undecided = 0.45)

# plotting membership values for group 2
maps1$ProbaMaps[[2]] + theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# plotting the most likely categories
maps1$ClusterPlot + theme(legend.position = "bottom") + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")

GFCMvalues <- select_parameters.mc(algo = "GFCM", data = aligned_rasts,
                             k = 4, m = seq(1.1,2,0.1), 
                             beta = seq(0.1,0.9,0.1),
                             spconsist = FALSE, verbose = TRUE, 
                             init = "kpp",
                             indices = c("XieBeni.index",
                                         "Explained.inertia",
                                         "Negentropy.index",
                                         "Silhouette.index"))

# plotting the explained inertia
ggplot(GFCMvalues) + 
  geom_raster(aes(x = m, y = beta, fill = Explained.inertia)) + 
  geom_text(aes(x = m, y = beta, label = round(Explained.inertia,2)), size = 2)+
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_fixed(ratio=1)

# plotting the silhouette index
ggplot(GFCMvalues) + 
  geom_raster(aes(x = m, y = beta, fill = Silhouette.index)) + 
  geom_text(aes(x = m, y = beta, label = round(Silhouette.index,2)), size = 2)+
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_fixed(ratio=1)

# choosing k=4, m=1.3, b=0.8

GFCM_result <- GCMeans(aligned_rasts, k = 4, m = 1.3, beta = 0.8,
                       standardize = TRUE,
                       verbose = FALSE, seed = 789, tol = 0.001)

# reorganizing the groups for an easier comparison
GFCM_result <- groups_matching(FCM_result, GFCM_result)
maps2 <- mapClusters(object = GFCM_result, undecided = 0.45)

# plotting membership values for group 2
maps2$ProbaMaps[[2]] + theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# plotting the most likely categories
maps2$ClusterPlot + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
# groups 2 and 4 changed quite a bit actually

# on to spatial!
w1 <- matrix(1, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
w2 <- matrix(1, nrow = 5, ncol = 5)
w3 <- matrix(1, nrow = 7, ncol = 7)

future::plan(future::multisession(workers = 2))
SGFCMvalues <- select_parameters.mc(algo = "SGFCM", 
                                    data = aligned_rasts, k = 4, m = 1.3,
                             beta = 0.8, alpha = seq(0.5,2,0.1),
                             window = list(w1,w2,w3),
                             spconsist = TRUE, nrep = 5, 
                             verbose = TRUE, chunk_size = 4,
                             seed = 456, init = "kpp",
                             indices = c("XieBeni.index",
                                         "Explained.inertia",
                                         "Negentropy.index",
                                         "Silhouette.index"))

dict <- data.frame(
  w = c(1,2,3),
  window = c("3x3","5x5","7x7")
)

SGFCMvalues$window <- dict$window[match(SGFCMvalues$window,dict$w)]

# showing the silhouette index
ggplot(SGFCMvalues) + 
  geom_raster(aes(x = alpha, y = window, fill = Silhouette.index)) + 
  geom_text(aes(x = alpha, y = window, label = round(Silhouette.index,2)), size = 1.5)+
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_fixed(ratio=0.125)

# showing the explained inertia
ggplot(SGFCMvalues) + 
  geom_raster(aes(x = alpha, y = window, fill = Explained.inertia)) + 
  geom_text(aes(x = alpha, y = window, label = round(Explained.inertia,2)), size = 1.5)+
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_fixed(ratio=0.125)

# showing the spatial inconsistency
ggplot(SGFCMvalues) + 
  geom_raster(aes(x = alpha, y = window, fill = spConsistency)) + 
  geom_text(aes(x = alpha, y = window, label = round(spConsistency,2)), size = 1.5)+
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_fixed(ratio=0.125)

SGFCM_result <- SGFCMeans(aligned_rasts, k = 4, m = 1.3, standardize = TRUE,
                       lag_method = "mean",
                       window = w1, alpha = 0.5, beta = 0.8,
                       seed = 789, tol = 0.001, verbose = FALSE, 
                       init = "kpp")

# reorganizing the groups for an easier comparison
SGFCM_result <- groups_matching(FCM_result, SGFCM_result)

maps3 <- mapClusters(object = SGFCM_result, undecided = 0.2)

# plotting membership values for group 2
maps3$ProbaMaps[[4]] + theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# plotting the most likely categories
maps3$ClusterPlot + theme(legend.position = "bottom") + 
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")

cluster_results <- list(FCM_result, GFCM_result, SGFCM_result)

indices <- sapply(cluster_results, function(clust){
  c(calcexplainedInertia(clust$Data, clust$Belongings),
    calcSilhouetteIdx(clust$Data, clust$Belongings),
    spConsistency(clust, window = w1, nrep = 5)$Mean)
})

colnames(indices) <- c("FCM", "GFCM", "SGFCM")
rownames(indices) <- c("explained inertia", "silhouette index", "spatial inconsistency")

knitr::kable(indices, digits = 3)

# checks
diagGFCM <- spatialDiag(GFCM_result, window = matrix(1, nrow = 3, ncol = 3), nrep = 5)
knitr::kable(diagGFCM$MoranValues, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)

plot(GFCM_result)
```

Spatial clusters by county

```{r}
### Summarizing function

sum_cover <- function(x){
  list(x %>%
    group_by(value) %>%
    summarize(total_area = sum(coverage_area)) %>%
    mutate(proportion = total_area/sum(total_area)))
  
}

#extract the area of each raster cell covered by the plot and summarize
x <- exact_extract(GFCM_result$rasters$Groups, 
                   aoi, 
                   coverage_area = TRUE, 
                   summarize_df = TRUE, fun = sum_cover)

#add plot names to the elements of the output list
names(x) <- aoi$NAME

#merge the list elements into a df
NCP_clusts_by_county <- bind_rows(x, .id = "NAME")

NCP_clusts_by_county %>%
  left_join(., aoi) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(alpha = proportion, fill = factor(value))) +
  facet_wrap(vars(value), ncol=2) +
  theme_void()
```
